description: A player character on a sunlit outdoor platform level (trees, a large sun, grass-topped dirt platforms) walks a short distance, jumps once, then aims up, right, down, and diagonally in turn while their hook-collision guide line display setting is turned on, and finally fires their grapple hook twice.
reproduces: https://github.com/ddnet/ddnet/issues/10943 (bug item 5: "hook line breaks with some tunings `tune hook_fire_speed 1`, `tune hook_length 99999` in multiple ways")
scenario: Real DDNet client+server at the base commit, playing dm1.map (a shipped DM map): the server is tuned to hook_fire_speed=0.9 (below 1, one of the exact tuning values the reporter names), the player's own "always show my hook collision line" display setting is turned on, the player walks and jumps, then sweeps their aim across open sky in several directions (up, right, down, a diagonal) and fires the hook for real twice.
